3namespace Faker;
4
5class Documentor
6{
7    protected $generator;
8
9    public function __construct(Generator $generator)
10    {
11        $this->generator = $generator;
12    }
13
14    /**
15     * @return array
16     */
17    public function getFormatters()
18    {
19        $formatters = [];
20        $providers = array_reverse($this->generator->getProviders());
21        $providers[] = new Provider\Base($this->generator);
22
23        foreach ($providers as $provider) {
24            $providerClass = get_class($provider);
25            $formatters[$providerClass] = [];
26            $refl = new \ReflectionObject($provider);
27
28            foreach ($refl->getMethods(\ReflectionMethod::IS_PUBLIC) as $reflmethod) {
29                if ($reflmethod->getDeclaringClass()->getName() == 'Faker\Provider\Base' && $providerClass != 'Faker\Provider\Base') {
30                    continue;
31                }
32                $methodName = $reflmethod->name;
33
34                if ($reflmethod->isConstructor()) {
35                    continue;
36                }
37                $parameters = [];
38
39                foreach ($reflmethod->getParameters() as $reflparameter) {
40                    $parameter = '$' . $reflparameter->getName();
41
42                    if ($reflparameter->isDefaultValueAvailable()) {
43                        $parameter .= ' = ' . var_export($reflparameter->getDefaultValue(), true);
44                    }
45                    $parameters[] = $parameter;
46                }
47                $parameters = $parameters ? '(' . implode(', ', $parameters) . ')' : '';
48
49                try {
50                    $example = $this->generator->format($methodName);
51                } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
52                    $example = '';
53                }
54
55                if (is_array($example)) {
56                    $example = "array('" . implode("', '", $example) . "')";
57                } elseif ($example instanceof \DateTime) {
58                    $example = "DateTime('" . $example->format('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "')";
59                } elseif ($example instanceof Generator || $example instanceof UniqueGenerator) { // modifier
60                    $example = '';
61                } else {
62                    $example = var_export($example, true);
63                }
64                $formatters[$providerClass][$methodName . $parameters] = $example;
65            }
66        }
67
68        return $formatters;
69    }
